name: Typescript Sdk
headline: TypeScript SDK for Model Context Protocol
short_description: The TypeScript SDK for Model Context Protocol enables integration for developers building applications with Model Context Protocol servers and clients. It simplifies the development process, ensuring efficient communication and data handling.
author: modelcontextprotocol

sections.overview:
The TypeScript SDK provides official tooling for developers integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) into their applications. It includes packages, examples, and utilities for building both MCP servers and clients with standardized request/response handling. The SDK supports custom method handling through request schema definition and includes transport abstractions for different communication patterns. Developers can leverage type-checked examples and comprehensive documentation to accelerate MCP implementation. The project maintains backward compatibility across versions and is actively maintained with regular updates.
Build applications that utilize Model Context Protocol for efficient data handling.
Integrate TypeScript with backend services to streamline communication.
Create robust client-server communication protocols for real-time data exchange.
Develop data-driven applications that require seamless integration with external services.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: VS Code, GitHub Copilot
